CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFRETHROW

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

CFRETHROW hands the exception being handled on to the next outer CFTRY (or to the standard error page), exactly as it was raised, with the same type, message and other CFCATCH values. Use it when a catch block wants to look at an error, perhaps log it or clean up, but leave the real handling to someone else.

Category

Exception handling

Syntax

<CFRETHROW>

Usage

CFRETHROW may only be used inside a CFCATCH block. A typical pattern is a catch block that handles the cases it knows about and rethrows the rest:

<CFCATCH TYPE="Any">
  <CFIF CFCATCH.Type IS NOT "MyApp.NoSuchCustomer"><CFRETHROW></CFIF>
  Sorry, we have no customer with that number.
</CFCATCH>

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- The inner handler notes the error, then passes it to the outer one --->
<CFSET Log = "">
<CFTRY>
  <CFTRY>
    <CFQUERY NAME="Report" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
    SELECT ParkName FROM ParksOf1999
    </CFQUERY>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Database">
    <CFSET Log = "Inner handler saw a Database error at " & TimeFormat(Now(), "h:mm:ss tt")>
    <CFRETHROW>
  </CFCATCH>
  </CFTRY>
  <P>This line is never reached.</P>
<CFCATCH TYPE="Any">
  <CFOUTPUT>
  <TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
  <TR><TD BGCOLOR="##FFFFCC">Inner handler</TD><TD>#Log#</TD></TR>
  <TR><TD BGCOLOR="##FFFFCC">Outer handler</TD><TD>Caught the same error again:<BR>
      Type <B>#CFCATCH.Type#</B>, SQLState <B>#CFCATCH.SQLState#</B><BR>#CFCATCH.Message#</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
  </CFOUTPUT>
</CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
